messages:
michael: Quick sync: after yesterday's spike small tenants hit long tails. Proposal: soft-ticket (deferred reservation) + age-watermark prioritizer. Short notes and next steps.

dana: How does soft-ticket differ from current enqueue/deadline hints?

michael: Instead of allocating slab immediately, admission issues a tiny ticket that reserves the right to convert into a slot for T ms. If a compatible batch forms token->slot; else it expires. No slab allocated until convert.

ryan: Tenant abuse?

michael: Per-tenant concurrent ticket cap + a tiny ticket_cost that increments tenant debt. High debt reduces ticket acceptance. Debt decays over time.

lee: Age-watermark?

michael: Coalescer adds age_boost to score. Watermark is dynamic (median waiting age) so older tickets get prioritized to avoid starvation.

sam: KV affinity?

michael: Ticket carries small kv_hint hash. On convert prefer batches with matching hint; emit prefetch_hint if no match. Maintain hash->batch buckets for O(1) candidate lookup.

ryan: Risks: memory churn, index churn when batches close; telemetry cardinality.

michael: Mitigations: tiny ticket struct, ring buffer + batched GC, coarse telemetry tags.

infra-bot: deploy queued PR 6182 -> staging, canary=10%, owner=michael

michael: Next steps: 1) run batcher-sim with hot-large + many small mix and kv_miss penalty, sweep ticket_lifetime/cap; 2) perf bench for allocation/GC; 3) staging canary with telemetry gates (small_tenant_p95, overall_throughput, ticket_conversion_rate). I'll post results tomorrow.

dana: Also add rollback playbook and kill-switch.

michael: Added. Thanks :thumbsup:
